evidence.cohort: 33 goalies with at least 2 official starts; baselines use every goalie with a start, week by week. Ranked by Category Counts: games net (better minus worse results), then week net, then share better; equal goalies share a rank; lower GAA counts as better. TGV grade (existing method) is a separate method, not applied to Category Counts; Average cannot occur with its three default stats
